title: Convicted by a Ghost
sentences: In Salem, you could be convicted because someone said your spirit attacked them.
Accusers said the specter of the accused tormented them, where no one else could see.
It counted even when the accused was somewhere else entirely.
It was almost impossible to disprove.
In October 1692, Increase Mather argued it was better that ten suspected witches escape than one innocent person be condemned.
Once courts stopped accepting it, most of the accused went free.
